title: Project Unity flagged by the DoD as a Russian disinformation platform

tellings.quote: well I got told that I was flagged as a Russian disinformation platform by the DoD apparently but they're still letting me in the country so I was flagged as Russian

plain: A guest named Jay Anderson says the Department of Defense flagged his platform, Project Unity, as a Russian disinformation outlet. He tells Michels he only heard this from someone else ("I got told that I was flagged"), and jokes that they are still letting him into the country. If true, it would mean the Pentagon was keeping an eye on people who talk publicly about these subjects.
